title: EventEnvelope
description: Wrapper carried by every Kafka message in LedgerGuard. The envelope is what makes tracing, causality, idempotency, and schema evolution possible; the payload alone would not.

eventId.description: UUIDv7. The consumer dedupe key: (consumerGroup, eventId) is unique.

aggregateId.description: The Kafka partition key. This is what gives per-aggregate ordering; there is no global ordering.

recordedAt.description: Persistence time, UTC. occurredAt to recordedAt is the ingestion delay.

correlationId.description: One business flow, end to end. Minted at the gateway if absent.

causationId.description: The eventId or commandId that DIRECTLY caused this event. Null for flow roots.

traceparent.description: W3C trace context. Propagated across the broker hop so one traceId spans all services.

schemaRef.description: Path to the JSON Schema validating payload, e.g. schemas/TransactionReceived/v2.json
